technique_notes: Rule-based prompting: explicit, checkable formatting rules (bullet count, word limit, no repeated leading words). Checks constraint compliance.

messages.content: Follow these rules strictly: (1) Respond in exactly 3 bullet points. (2) Each bullet must be 10 words or fewer. (3) No bullet may start with the same word as another.
Explain why regular exercise is beneficial for health.

response:
